You'll declare our glorious unity while I patch up the chaos that has unfolded, yet again, behind your back. Mend what you must, but bear in mind that words alone won't fix what’s been broken. Let’s see action for once, Brother. And for our future sakes, try and remember that chaos is supposed to be my domain!
